description: This file contains the implementation of the DateCalculator user control in a Windows UWP application, including initialization, date range setup, event handlers for date changes, UI interactions, and accessibility features.

classes.name: DateCalculator
classes.description: A user control for date calculations, managing date pickers, localization, and user interactions.

methods.name: DateCalculator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the date calculator control, setting up localization, date ranges, and UI elements.

methods.description: Closes any open calendar flyouts for date pickers.

methods.description: Sets focus to the date calculation option control.

methods.description: Event handler for changes in the 'To Date' picker, updating the view model.

methods.name: OffsetValue_Changed

methods.description: Placeholder for loaded event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: DateCalcOption_Changed
